abudawud:1400.note: Abu Hurayrah; a surah of thirty verses pleads for its reader until forgiven (Al-Mulk)

abudawud:1416.note: Ali; Allah is single (witr) and loves what is single; people of the Qur'an told to pray witr

abudawud:1425.note: al-Hasan ibn Ali taught the Qunut words for witr; page does not say before/after ruku

abudawud:162.note: Ali; saw the Prophet wipe the top of the khuffs; underside would be fitter by opinion; khuffs not socks

abudawud:181.note: Busrah bint Safwan; whoever touches his private part should make wudu

abudawud:2130.note: Abu Hurayrah; supplication for the newly married (barakallahu laka ... jama'a baynakuma fi khayr)

abudawud:2880.note: cited for "learn the faraid": 2880 is the three deeds that continue after death (Abu Hurayrah); the faraid report is Ibn Majah 2719 (da'if per Darussalam)

abudawud:3102.note: cited for the visit-the-sick supplication; the hadith is Abu Dawud 3106 (checked on sunnah.com); 3102 not fetched

abudawud:3106.note: Ibn Abbas; visiting the sick, seven times asking Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to cure him

abudawud:3201.note: funeral prayer dua (forgive our living and our dead...), narrated by Abu Hurayrah; matches the app wording

abudawud:3755.note: cited for washing hands before and after eating; 3755 is Ali and the decorated curtain (hasan per al-Albani); the washing report is 3761 (da'if)

abudawud:3761.note: Salman al-Farsi; washing before and after the meal brings blessing; weak, app says weak report

abudawud:3764.note: Wahshi ibn Harb; eat together and mention Allah's name, blessed in it; page does not mention Satan, app claim removed

abudawud:3767.note: Aisha; if one forgets to mention Allah at the start of the meal say bismillah awwalahu wa akhirahu

abudawud:3850.note: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri; praise to Allah who fed and gave drink and made us Muslims; sunnah.com shows al-Albani grade as da'if, app says so

abudawud:4104.note: Aisha; Asma' in thin clothing; only face and hands; Abu Dawud himself says mursal, al-Albani grades sahih; app states both

abudawud:4895.note: Iyad ibn Himar; Allah revealed that you should be humble so none boasts over or wrongs another

abudawud:5045.note: dua asking protection from punishment on the day of resurrection when lying down, hand under cheek

abudawud:5088.note: Uthman ibn Affan; "In the name of Allah" formula three times morning and evening protects from sudden calamity; NOT the Ikhlas/Mu'awwidhatayn set

abudawud:802.note: cited for "have mercy on yourself" to Ibn Umar; 802 is the Prophet standing long in the first rak'ah of Zuhr (Ibn Abi Awfa, da'if); the Ibn Umar claim could not be sourced and was removed

bukhari:1403.note: Abu Hurayrah; unpaid zakat wealth becomes a bald venomous snake; Prophet recited 3:180

bukhari:1410.note: Abu Hurayrah; charity from lawful earnings even a date is accepted and grown; the "extinguishes sin like water extinguishes fire" wording is NOT here (it is Tirmidhi 2616)

bukhari:1782.note: Ibn Abbas; Umrah in Ramadan equals Hajj (in reward), said to an Ansari woman; text does not say "with me"

bukhari:2044.note: Prophet did i'tikaf ten days each Ramadan, twenty in the year he died (Abu Hurayrah)

bukhari:2363.note: man gave water to a thirsty dog; Allah accepted the deed and forgave him

bukhari:4563.note: Ibn Abbas; hasbunallah wa ni'mal wakil said first by Ibrahim in the fire and by the Prophet when told people had gathered (3:173)

bukhari:5009.note: Abu Mas'ud; last two verses of al-Baqarah at night suffice him; no "beneath the Throne" clause here

bukhari:5376.note: Umar ibn Abi Salama; mention Allah, eat with the right hand, from what is nearest

ibnmajah:2719.note: Abu Hurayrah; learn and teach inheritance, half of knowledge, first thing lifted

muslim:1098.note: Sahl ibn Sa'd; people remain in good while they hasten the iftar

muslim:2107.note: cited for the severest punishment for image makers; 2107 is the curtain/angels report (Abu Talha, Aisha)

muslim:2109.note: Ibn Mas'ud; the makers of images are the most severely punished on the Day of Resurrection

muslim:244.note: cited for sins leaving from beneath the nails; 244 (Abu Hurayrah) says sins of face, hands and feet leave with the water; the fingernails wording is Muslim 245 (Uthman)

muslim:245.note: Uthman ibn Affan; whoever performs wudu well, his sins come out of his body, even from beneath his fingernails

muslim:2568.note: Thawban; the visitor of a sick person is in the fruit garden of Paradise until he returns

muslim:2605.note: Umm Kulthum; one who reconciles people by saying good is not a liar; the three permitted cases are Ibn Shihab al-Zuhri's comment, not the Prophet's words

muslim:2607.note: Ibn Mas'ud; truthfulness to righteousness to Paradise, lying to wickedness to the Fire; no exceptions here

muslim:2865.note: humility clause (be humble so none boasts or wrongs another) is NOT on the Muslim 2865 page (Iyad ibn Himar long hadith: wealth, devils, people of Paradise and Hell); it is Abu Dawud 4895, sahih per al-Albani; app now cites 4895

muslim:394.note: no valid prayer without the Opening of the Book

muslim:516.note: cited for "Allahumma habbib ilayna al-iman"; 516 is about not praying in a single garment leaving the shoulder bare (Abu Hurayrah); the dua is not in Muslim; claim replaced by Qur'an 49:7

muslim:54.note: you will not enter Paradise until you believe, nor believe until you love one another; spread salam

muslim:761.note: Aisha; the Prophet prayed in the mosque, people joined on two nights, stayed away on the third or fourth fearing it would be obligatory

muslim:808.note: the last two verses of al-Baqarah at night suffice (per the app wording)

muslim:899.note: Aisha; 899a: his unease at wind/clouds, relief at rain; 899b: the supplication asking for the wind's good and refuge from its evil; app claim matches 899b

nasai:3104.note: man asks to fight; Prophet says stay with her, Paradise is beneath her feet

tirmidhi:1155.note: cited for the wife who prays, fasts, guards her chastity, obeys her husband; 1155 is Barirah's choice after being freed; that report is Musnad Ahmad (not checkable here), so the quote was removed

tirmidhi:1862.note: Ibn Umar; prayer of one who drinks khamr not accepted for forty days; repents and Allah accepts; al-Tirmidhi himself called it hasan

tirmidhi:2616.note: Mu'adh ibn Jabal; charity extinguishes sins like water extinguishes fire (the long deeds hadith)

tirmidhi:2875.note: nothing like the Opening revealed in the Tawrah, Injil, Zabur or Furqan

tirmidhi:2890.note: Ibn Abbas; Surah al-Mulk delivers from the punishment of the grave; al-Tirmidhi called it hasan gharib

tirmidhi:3773.note: cited for forty days of prayer not accepted; 3773 is the virtue of al-Hasan (Abu Bakrah); the khamr report is Tirmidhi 1862
